A lot of you know, when I dropped out of school at just 17 years old, I got my first job working at the Waffle House at College Park Road in Ladson. My parents told me if I wasn't going to go to school, I had to go to work.

From there I went on to become the first female to graduate from the Corps of Cadets at The Citadel, where I was taught discipline, accountability, leadership, and how to keep going even when things got tough.

We’ve tried multiple times to remove Ilhan Omar from Congress, but have been consistently blocked from doing so.

Our Constitutional Amendment to ensure anyone serving in the federal government was born in America is something we need ahead of the midterms this year.

We work for America, and America ONLY.

Video

When the people of South Carolina sent us to Washington, we made a promise: to work for YOU.

We have NEVER voted to raise your taxes in Congress because when you work hard for your money, it should stay in your pockets.

South Carolina STRONG.

President Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill has been delivering for South Carolina and we backed it from the very first day.

It puts hardworking families first by prioritizing tax relief, cutting Washington waste, and making sure South Carolinians keep more of what they earn.

It restores law and order at the border by ending failed policies and giving law enforcement the tools they need to keep our communities safe.

It fully supports our military. Ensuring the men and women at Joint Base Charles

American taxpayers are being taken advantage of and most have no idea it is happening.

Sanctuary cities block ICE, refuse to share immigration information with federal authorities, and turn their cities into safe havens for criminal illegal immigrants. All while collecting tax-exempt financing through municipal bonds.

Military families sacrifice more than most Americans will ever understand.

Right now, pregnancy is not even considered a qualifying life event under TRICARE. This means expectant military moms and spouses cannot change their healthcare plan to meet their maternal care needs.

President Trump is the law and order president.

Before Congress, there was The Citadel.

I was the first woman to graduate from the Corps of Cadets.

Nothing was handed to me there. In fact, I didn't even tell my father I had applied and was accepted until after the fact. 

This is the place where we salute the American flag, not burn it to the ground. This is where you go to learn grit, discipline, and to be strong.

This is where I learned what I was made of. And those lessons have never left me.

Everyone is moving to South Carolina.

Last year alone, nearly 80,000 new residents chose to call our state home. They are coming for our coastlines, our warm weather, our communities, our hospitality and our way of life. South Carolina has become the state everyone wants to be in, and the numbers prove it.

We pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America. Our allegiance lies with the United States ONLY.

Foreign-born members sitting in our government have made clear time and again their loyalty is not here. Not to our laws. Not to our people. Not to our flag. We are closing the loophole permanently. 

We introduced a joint resolution proposing a constitutional amendment to require Members of Congress, federal judges, and Senate-confirmed officers of the United States to be natural

South Carolina is not Big Tech's personal power grid.

Data centers are planting themselves across our state, driving up energy demand, and leaving families and small businesses to pick up the tab. South Carolinians are already stretched thin. The last thing they need is a higher electricity bill subsidizing Big Tech's bottom line.

We called for a one-year moratorium on new data center construction in South Carolina. It gives lawmakers the time needed to put real protections in place. When it i

Unvetted immigration from third world countries has consequences. We have seen this.

We just introduced the No Immigration Without Assimilation Act to give the Department of Homeland Security the tools to conduct a full screening process. Foreign nationals who hold views incompatible with the principles of the United States, refuse to assimilate into American culture, or whose presence would be detrimental to American cultural cohesion will be denied entry.

Lowcountry veterans are a top priority. Always.

No veteran should ever be homeless. No veteran should ever have to choose between a meal and a roof. No veteran should ever feel abandoned by the country they served.

We supported a $100,000 grant for the Veteran Recovery Coalition to expand critical services for Lowcountry veterans, helping them avoid homelessness, return to work or school, prevent financial hardship, and rebuild their independence through coordinated assistance and financial ov

300,000 unaccompanied alien children were released without proper documentation under the Biden administration, leaving them vulnerable to traffickers, predators, and cartels.

This is one of the greatest child protection failures in American history.

We introduced the No More Missing Children Act, legislation implementing strict safeguards to ensure children remain safe. This includes:

-Extensive vetting of the sponsor
-GPS monitoring of both the child and sponsor
-Pre-placement home inspecti

Law and order starts with a justice system willing to follow the law.

Right now, unelected activist judges are bypassing the Senate confirmation process and undermining the president's constitutional authority to appoint U.S. Attorneys. After the 120-day interim term expires, federal judges are installing their own picks indefinitely. No Senate confirmation. No accountability. No end date.

A judicial power grab being used to override the will of the American people and block President Trump fr

PFAS chemicals are in our water, our soil, and our communities. Our seniors deserve to know if these forever chemicals are in their blood.

We cosponsored the Expanding Seniors' Access to PFAS Testing Act to require Medicare to cover PFAS blood testing for seniors.

Early detection saves lives. And a Medicare program working for our seniors, not against them, is exactly what they deserve.

We are standing up for every senior in the Lowcountry and across South Carolina. Your health is worth prote

Our daughters are worth protecting. Logan Federico's life was worth protecting. Logan Federico deserved to come home.

The South Carolina system of injustice failed her. Every judge who released her killer. Every politician who pushed soft-on-crime policies.
